svg.title: 智扫通——石头 T8 智能客服系统架构图
svg.desc: React、FastAPI、LangGraph Agent、Hybrid Retrieval、安全交付、Review Publication、Memory 与 Docker Compose 架构。
svg.text: 智扫通——石头 T8 智能客服系统
AI Agent / RAG 工程架构 · 可追溯手册证据 · 安全交付与显式发布
Audit first · conditional semantic check · explicit outcomes
owner-scoped extraction; separate from session sliding memory
Troubleshooting Intake · 故障信息采集
error-code fast path · readiness, not explanation
max 2 tool calls · one real Retrieval snapshot
model arguments do not control query
E1–E3 · same snapshot replayed as Tool Observation
citations · money · personal runtime and other program-checkable risks
one internal draft / evidence snapshot commit
Static Knowledge Boundary · 能力边界
manual capability vs personal live-device state
program blocks first · determines whether Gate is required
Conditional Semantic Grounding Gate · 证据核验
evidence support · fail closed · invoked only when required
Final Answer Release Policy · 安全交付
delivery status is distinct from internal review / publication
SSE first status ≈110 ms (not full answer latency)
Main path is solid. Dashed paths are conditional / optional; long-term memory is user-derived and disabled for default Agent injection.
messages / snapshot / Draft; not session history
